recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖而非形態照片：粉紅色族群為 CD117 強陽性、CD33 陽性、側散射（SSC）偏高的肥大細胞，且同時表現 CD2 與 CD25，這種異常共表現就是系統性肥大細胞增生症（SM）的非典型肥大細胞。
features: Four-panel flow cytometry dot plots gated on mast cells (magenta population)
CD117 bright / CD33 positive population distinct from CD117-negative myeloid (green) and lymphoid (blue) events
Mast cells show moderate CD45 with intermediate-high side scatter
Aberrant co-expression of CD2 and CD25 on the CD117-bright population
Small event count consistent with a minor population in a post-therapy marrow
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of a post-induction bone marrow aspirate identifies a discrete population of mast cells defined by bright CD117 and CD33 expression, moderate CD45 and relatively high side scatter. This population aberrantly co-expresses CD25 and CD2, a phenotype that fulfils a minor WHO criterion for systemic mastocytosis. No morphology can be assessed from this figure; correlation with the aspirate (spindled atypical mast cell aggregates), tryptase and KIT D816 status is required. In the setting of treated t(8;21) AML with KIT D816H, the findings support systemic mastocytosis with an associated myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are CD117 bright but lack aberrant CD25 and CD2 expression.
Myeloblasts are CD117 dim-moderate with low side scatter and CD34/HLA-DR expression, not CD117 bright with high SSC and CD25.
Basophils are CD123 bright/HLA-DR negative and CD117 negative, unlike this CD117-bright population.
